Matt: Quick q — onboarding failing for some community models that use a custom SentencePiece/tokenizer combo. Root errors are tokenization mismatch on eval samples and weird generation truncation. Anyone run into this?

Sara: yep seen it. Usually it's 1) vocab id > model embedding size, or 2) tokenizer normalizes differently causing token count mismatch.

Jess: Suggest a fast preflight: sample N inputs, run tokenizer encode/decode roundtrip and compare length distribution. If >5% mismatch, mark as 'needs manual review'.

Kyle: can we do that cheaply? deepbench already heavy.

Matt: propose a lightweight probe 'tokenizer-smoke' in intake that runs 200 samples. If it passes, continue to fastpath onboarding; else route to deepbench.

ingest-bot: run 1749993210 | tokenizer-smoke queued on worker-12 :gear:

Sara: heuristics: check for unknown_token_rate, largest_token_id >= embedding_size, and sentencepiece-normalizer-diff. Here are rough commands:

```
python tools/tokenizer_smoke.py --model-dir /tmp/model --samples 200 --out /tmp/smoke.json
jq . /tmp/smoke.json
```

Jess: thresholds I'd use: unknown_rate < 0.02, id_overflow_count == 0, roundtrip_median_ratio between 0.8 and 1.2. adjust by model family.

Kyle: edgecase: byte-level models will trip unknowns but are fine. Need model metadata flag 'tokenizer_type' to skip or use alternate checks.

Matt: agreed. Action items: 1) add tokenizer_type metadata field, 2) add tokenizer-smoke probe to preflight, 3) persist tokenizer-fingerprint in registry, 4) RFC for deepbench followups. Anyone want to own the probe impl?

Sara: I'll pick it up. Plan to PR tests + tool in next sprint.

Jess: I'll draft RFC for fingerprint schema and registry fields.

Kyle: I'll update onboard docs and fastpath routing to respect the new probe results.

Matt: thanks. One more: we should avoid >2s median added latency. Make probe run async and block only if it fails; otherwise let async checks update status.

Sara: good call. I'll implement async worker + quick sync timeout 3s.

Matt: cool. tagging @Jess for RFC. +1 :thumbsup:
